hypotheses.justification: The library defines `Place.ord f := -(WithZero.log (v.adicValuation f))` and proves `Place.ord_zero : v.ord (0 : F) = 0` (line 268 of the same file). So when f = 0 the conclusion `(placeInfty K).ord 0 = 0` holds no matter what `h` says (and `intDegree 0 = 0` anyway). Proof without hf: `rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf`. The zero case is `exact (placeInfty K).ord_zero`. The nonzero case is the existing proof, which uses hf only in `ord_eq_zero_iff_adicValuation_eq_one` and `RatFunc.inftyValuation_of_nonzero`.
